title: Saponaria officinalis tea for medicinal use
intro: Saponaria officinalis tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried flowers and leaves of the soapwort plant. It is traditionally used in herbalism for its mild diuretic and expectorant properties. This tea is often brewed to help alleviate respiratory congestion and support urinary tract health. Its saponin content gives it a slight foaming quality when mixed with water. It is typically consumed as a mild tonic to promote overall wellness and detoxification.
